(śeṣa)cakrapāṇi
(1443-1493 A. D.). grandson of Śeṣa Kṛṣṇa; younger son an. pupil of Viśveśvara or Vīreśvara; younger brother of Śeṣa Puruṣottama; an. father of Śeṣa Gopīnātha.
--Kārakatattva or ºvicāra. See NCC. III. p. 275a; also Samskṛta Vyākaraṇa Śāstra kā Itihās I. p.. 487-495.
--Prakriyāpradīpa. gr. ref. to by a. in his Prauḍhamanoramākhaṇḍana, IO. 728. See Ind. Ant. 51. p. 251.
--Prauḍhamanoramākhaṇḍana or Paramatakhaṇḍana. Bikaner 5880-82. IO. 728. TCD. 517A.
Pt.. Pandit Reprints 50.

(śeṣa)candrikācārya
a. alias of Raghunāthatīrtha.
See BNK. Sarma, His.. of Dvai. Lit. II. p. 301.

(Śeṣa)cintāmaṇi
of the 16th Cent.; son of Śeṣa Kṛṣṇa; resident of Bradhnapura.

--C. on Meghadūta. B. II. 98.
--C. Parimala on Rasamañjarī of Bhānudatta. Adyar D. V. 1813.
--Rukmiṇīharaṇanāṭaka. B. II. 122.
